tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind every pane. Pair with `foreground`. Not for cards, popovers or the sidebar — they have their own surfaces.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on `background`, `card`, `popover` (≥17:1 in both themes). Also the checked Switch track and the Tooltip fill.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Panels lifted off the canvas (Card, settings groups). Pair with `card-foreground`. Never the canvas itself.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Opaque floating surfaces (Command root, hovercards). Menus and Select use the translucent menu recipe (primitives/primitives.css, shadow-menu) instead.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The single affirmative action in a flow (Save, Confirm, Create) — default Button, default Badge, checked Checkbox. Never decoration, hover or secondary actions.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (≥17:1 both themes).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Lower-emphasis filled action beside a `primary` one; KeyCap fill (70%).

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: Tabs list track, Command input wrapper (30%).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: De-emphasized text: captions, descriptions, placeholders (at 60%), menu icons, shortcut chips. 4.7:1 on `background` light, 7.7:1 dark — keep it on `background`/`card`; on `muted` light it is 4.3:1, so only for 11px+ semibold meta there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover/active ground for ghost buttons and list rows; Command item highlight. Not for solid buttons (use `secondary`). On light popovers it is nearly invisible — use the jump-palette selection recipe.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, discard, irreversible actions; error text and invalid-field borders. Never Cancel. Destructive Button text is white; dark mode fills at 60%.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Source pair kept exact, both flagged. Light: tint text over `destructive` at 4.47:1 — just under 4.5:1, fine for 14px medium button text only at its current weight. Dark value is a deeper red that does NOT read on `destructive` (≈1.7:1) — components use white on the 60% destructive fill instead; do not pair these two in dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: dividers, card edges, outline Button, Checkbox. Decorative only (1.3:1) — never the sole signal of a control boundary that matters; that is `ring` or `input`.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form field outline (Input, Textarea, Select trigger); dark fields fill with it at 30% (hover 50%).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus-visible outline: 3px at 50% plus a `ring` border. Selection halos. Never persistent decoration. Flag: the source value is 2.6:1 on `background` in light (#737373 on #0a0a0a is 4.2:1 in dark) — under the 3:1 floor for focus rings; kept exact, raise it in main.css before relying on the ring alone.

tokens.name: editor-surface
tokens.usage: Background of Monaco and the markdown editor panes (VS Code convention: slightly lifted in dark). Not app chrome.

tokens.name: sidebar

tokens.name: sidebar-primary

spacing.note: Tailwind v4 spacing: one step = 0.25rem (4px); space-N equals Tailwind p-N / gap-N. Orca uses the default scale; these are the steps its primitives and the Workbench overlay use.

shadow.note: Three elevation levels only: hairline (border, no shadow), subtle lift (shadow-xs / shadow-sm), floating (shadow-floating, and the menu / dialog recipes shadow-menu, shadow-dialog). Never a fourth.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Subtle lift: outline Button, Input, Checkbox, dot Badge.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Card, active tab, Switch thumb, KeyCap.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Floating: popups that escape the editor surface. Reserved — never add a fourth level.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Part of the floating level: the dropdown-menu recipe (also Select at 16px/36px). Pair with the translucent menu surface.

tokens.usage: Part of the floating level: Dialog and Command dialog.
